//: grok-x-farm unified config. Copy to farm.config.json and edit. All secrets can also come from env vars (they win over this file).

farm.//threads: 1-2 max: Turnstile serializes on shared browser

email.//provider: tmail | luckmail | mailnest | fce | gptmail | gmail | outlook | imap | 1secmail | tempmail-lol. fce = pure API no browser. gmail = +alias from one base mailbox. tmail/gptmail need headed Chrome.

gmail.//: uses +alias derivatives of base_email via IMAP

imap.//: generic IMAP via env: IMAP_HOST IMAP_PORT IMAP_USER IMAP_PASS IMAP_SSL IMAP_ALIAS_MODE(plus|dot|none)

1secmail.//: pure REST API, no keys needed. shared domains - fallback only

captcha.//mode: free_browser (patchright + turnstile.render, default, $0) | yescaptcha | capsolver | nopecha | 2captcha — paid solver fallback when free solver starts failing; first provider in fallback_order with a key wins

proxy.//single: http://user:pass@host:port — REQUIRED non-RU geo (xAI geo-blocks RU egress)

gateway.//parse_model: Web pool — the ONLY model with native live X search
